newsitem.title: USA: D&P upgrades Apache debt rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P upgrades Apache debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said on Wednesday that it upgraded Apapche Corp's senior debt and medium term notes to a rating of single-A-minus from triple-B-plus.
Apache's convertible subordinated eurobonds were raised to a rating of triple-B-plus from triple-B and its commerical paper to a rating of D-1-minus from D-2.
This action affects almost $550 million in outstanding securities, D&P said in a statement.

D&P said it based its upgrade on Apache's shift away from large-scale acquisitions toward increasing reserves through the exploitation and exploration of properties that the company already owns. This should lead to stronger credit quality, it said.
Apache explores for, develops and produces natural gas and crude oil.
